outcasts.name: Earthbound
outcasts.description: Roughly three parts human to one part dog. Isolation and contempt have made them self-reliant scavengers.
specialties: Excellent cooking (d4 extra HP when resting)

outcasts.name: Wild Wickhead
outcasts.description: Wildest and vilest cast from their solitary community. Fickle, suspicious, and bad.
specialties: Backstab (GM d20 DR8, weapon dmg + 3); carries up to five items

outcasts.name: Pale One
outcasts.description: As if fallen from the stars, the pale ones fit in nowhere. Destructive and detached.
specialties: Once/day: create d2 doses of a random decoction
Once/day: create d2 doses Elixir Vitalis (heals d6 HP and stops infection)
Once/day: use one random unclean Power
Once/day: use one random sacred Power
values: Not having to use their speciality all the time
A couple of hours alone in darkness

outcasts.name: Prowler
outcasts.description: Lawless good-for-nothing crooks banished from civilization, seeking retribution and coin.
specialties: Finds trails and corners that keep the group hidden (DR8)
